The cold light on The Ayakashi Hunter's Tainted Bride leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. The Ayakashi Hunter's Tainted Bride (Japanese: 傷モノの花嫁, Hepburn: Kizumono no Hanayome) is a Japanese manga series written by Midori Yūma and illustrated by Mamenosuke Fujimaru. A novel version began publication under Kodansha's Kodansha Taiga imprint in October 2023.

What looks like free choice in The Ayakashi Hunter's Tainted Bride is older than choice itself. He's outgoing and full of human touch, skilled in using two knives and the power of Thunder God in battles. Sosuke is the 6th Division member of The Imperial Chamber of the Onmyo (皇國陰陽寮) and Nanao's childhood friend and neighbor from Byakurenji Village.
